final: WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS state, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), shares AS (SELECT total, total * 1.0 / SUM(total) OVER () AS share FROM state_totals), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.total) AS combined_transaction_total, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value
